'''Ricmar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] residing on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beastmaster Ricmar was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Update 4.0. as an NPC on the fleet, who starts a short mission while unlocking multiple creature companions from the Cartel Market.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
